newsitem.title: USA: Commerce Banc raises payout, share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Banc raises payout, share buyback.

text.p: Commerce Bancshares Inc said Friday its directors approved increase in the company's quarterly dividend to $0.205 per share from $0.181.
The 13.3 percent increase is adjusted for a five percent stock dividend paid Dec 13, 1996.
The dividend is payable March 31 to shareholders of record March 7.

Commerce Bancshares also said its directors approved the additional purchase of up to 1,492,055 shares of the company's stock. This, coupled with the shares to be purchased under a prior authorization, will provide the company with authority to repurchase two million shares, it said in a statement.
Commerce Bancshares, a $9.7 billion-asset bank holding company, had about 37.4 million shares outstanding at the end of 1996.
Shares of Commerce Bancshares were up 1-1/8 at 47-3/4.
